entities.note: canopy u 18420-18706, v 1405-1465; runner (18513-18563, 1459-1516); pole seen to (18540, 1537), then hidden behind the tile-capped wall (foot est; t5 puts it at (18537, 1540)). SCALE: canopy about 285 px across.

entities.name: small signboard hung from the lower parasol
entities.what: Small upright signboard in a frame hanging from the west rim of the lower twin parasol; it carries two or three characters, illegible on this scan (□□; scholars name the stalls here 饮子).
entities.support: ground
entities.src: 名画记: 饮子 (pin 22)?
entities.note: board u 18453-18473, v 1460-1505, hung (not on a post). base = ground straight below (est). Its u is in t5's range; recorded here with the parasol it hangs from.

entities.name: small box under the lower parasol's east rim
entities.what: Small upright lidded box (a lamp-box sign or a chest) under the east rim of the lower twin parasol, just above the north end of the tile-capped wall.
entities.support: ground
entities.note: box u 18660-18693, v 1476-1500. Whether it stands on a post or hangs is not painted; base est.

entities.name: pole hung with curly goods
entities.what: Upright pole in a dark box-like stand, hung from about the height of a man to above his head with clusters of curly, twisted goods (strings of dough twists, toys or sweets?) on both sides: a pedlar's display pole.
entities.support: ground
entities.note: goods u 18730-18815, v 1240-1350; pole at u 18773; stand (18780-18820, 1333-1367) just above the north-west eave of the big roof S3.bld.bridge_foot_hall_19000; base est at the stand's foot. The restyle draws a straw bundle here.

entities.name: round woven object by the goods pole
entities.what: Round object with a looped rim (a basket, a lid or a round hat) beside the goods pole, on the roof ridge line.
entities.support: ground

entities.name: square table in the far-bank open hall
entities.what: Square wooden table on the raised floor of the open hall on posts at the far (north) bank, west of the bridge.
entities.support: upper floor: S3.bld.far_bank_hall_18520
entities.note: top u 18479-18536, v 214-229; legs at (18487, 260) and (18519, 260). UPPER FLOOR: the hall's floor edge at v 260-275 over u 18480-18600; its posts stand in the water at v ≈ 300 (S3.bld.far_bank_hall_18520, a raised plank deck on short stilts). The tables and benches west of u 18500 are t5's (t5 puts them on ground).

entities.name: bench in the far-bank open hall
entities.what: Low bench beside the square table on the raised floor of the far-bank open hall.
entities.support: upper floor: S3.bld.far_bank_hall_18520

entities.name: dark basket under the west stall's table
entities.what: Dark round basket or bucket set on the ground under the front of the west stall's table.
entities.support: bridge deck: 450 px west of the near edge
entities.note: u 18484-18518, v 737-766. Left to t6 by t5 (its base u 18500 is on the boundary).

entities.name: pile of coiled goods at the west stall
entities.what: Pile of round coiled goods (flat coils of twisted dough, or coiled baskets) heaped at the north-east end of the west stall's table and beyond it.
entities.support: bridge deck: 400 px west of the near edge
entities.note: goods u 18552-18646, v 553-634; base est under them at the table's level of feet. t5 reads them as goods hanging at the stall's east end.

entities.name: willow crown behind the deck crowd (west of the pair)
entities.what: Willow-like crown of many long thin whips, bare or just leafing, fanning up and out to the west from a trunk hidden behind the crowd at the deck's far (upstream) edge; the western of two such crowns side by side.
entities.support: ground
entities.vis: part: trunk hidden behind the deck crowd
entities.note: Its whips converge toward (18885-18902, 195-207); base est where the trunk would reach the ground behind the crowd (people with heads at v 210-290 hide it). The eastern crown converges at (18941-18969, 195-207): its tree is t7's by base. structures_e calls both willow crowns; the restyle paints a willow. Whether they stand on the north bank or on the water's edge west of the bridge is not painted.

entities.name: slatted stand of goods under the big parasol
entities.what: A slatted wooden frame (a crate, rack or stand of goods) under the big parasol, with a light box-like thing beside it to the west: the goods of the stall the parasol shades.
entities.support: ground
entities.note: frame u 18780-18823, v 999-1054 (vertical slats); light box u 18750-18770, v 1005-1035. Its foot is hidden by the crowd: base est where the people's feet are around it. Faded; no table can be read.

entities.name: slatted rack under the east mat awning
entities.what: Upright slatted wooden rack (shelves or a lattice stand) under the west side of the east mat awning, where the man in a dark cap works.
entities.support: bridge deck: 150 px west of the near edge
entities.note: rack u 18777-18818, v 727-791, between the awning's two west posts (u 18783 and 18815).

entities.name: the rider on the dark donkey
entities.what: A man in a light robe rides a dark donkey east toward the bridge's foot, whip in hand, a man walking at its head.

entities.name: the dark donkey on the ramp
entities.what: Two men bend over a small dark donkey on the ramp, one at its lowered head and one over the bundle on its back.
entities.src: 名画记: 拥挤的桥面 (pin 20)

entities.name: the west mat-awning stall
entities.what: A mat-awning stall with a table of coiled goods and bowls at the west side of the ramp's foot; a man on a bench at its corner holds a parasol over it.
entities.note: Its keepers under the awning (u 18350-18440) are t5's.

entities.name: the two donkeys with big sacks
entities.what: Two dark donkeys under huge pale sacks push through the crowd at the bridge's south foot, one heading north-west and one east; a man in a dark robe bends toward them calling out, and a child in red stands at the first donkey's head.
entities.note: Their driver is t5's S3.fig.donkey_walker_18481 (striding behind the first donkey). The third, dark donkey t6 recorded was the calling man's sleeves (retired at the second pass).

entities.name: the twin parasols (饮子 stall?)
entities.what: Two big flat parasols stand side by side behind the north end of the tile-capped wall, a small signboard hanging from one; a man stands under them, his head and shoulders above the wall.
entities.src: 名画记: 饮子 (pin 22)?
entities.note: The stall under them is hidden by the wall. The 饮子 identification is the pin's position (t5 reads it the same way), not a reading of the board.

entities.name: the mat-awning stall at the railing
entities.what: A mat-awning stall leaning on the bridge's near railing at the ramp's foot: a man works at its slatted rack and another stands under its edge.
